title: OAuth Assist for HA - provider profile (v1)
description: Declares which login pages and redirect URIs the extension watches for one provider. Profiles never configure a forward destination: captured codes only ever go to https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/oauth.

id.description: Short unique slug for the provider, e.g. "acme-app".

name.description: Human-readable provider name shown in the UI.

items.description: An https match pattern (e.g. "https://login.acme-app.com/*"). Enabling the profile requests a runtime host permission for each pattern.

capture.description: Capture steps. v1 supports only type "redirect"; the array form leaves room for future step types (e.g. an "initiation" handoff earlier in the flow).

items.description: URL prefix to intercept: a custom-scheme URI (e.g. "com.acme.app://") or an https prefix (e.g. "https://login.acme-app.com/ios/"). http:// and my.home-assistant.io are rejected.

rule.description: "ha-jwt": auto-forward only when state is a Home Assistant flow JWT (contains flow_id). "none": forward whenever code and state are present.

requestHeaders.description: Request-header changes applied to requests to the loginOrigins hosts only (e.g. a mobile User-Agent for an IdP that rejects desktop browsers). Only browser-identity headers may be changed: User-Agent and Sec-CH-UA / Sec-CH-UA-*. Each header may appear once.

header.description: Case-insensitive: User-Agent, Sec-CH-UA, or Sec-CH-UA-<hint> (e.g. Sec-CH-UA-Platform).
